title: (RHBA-2016:2408) rhythmbox bug fix update
portal_summary: An update for rhythmbox is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Desktop|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Workstation|7|x86_64
portal_solution:
For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Rhythmbox is an integrated music management application based on the GStreamer media framework.

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.3 Release Notes linked from the References section.

Users of rhythmbox are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
